verdict.rationale: The cloud observability docs describe polling ordered V4 run events with a cursor to monitor a run or build a custom UI. That gives a step-by-step event timeline that could support post-hoc debugging. The live preview / live_view_url only offers real-time human control, not recorded replay. missing for 10: recorded video replays of runs, per-step screenshots, a built-in replay/debug viewer for failed runs, independent or hands-on corroboration of replay debugging.
